headline: Israeli GDP Boom: +15.4% in the Quarter
summary: Statistical data show a double-digit quarterly rebound after a 2.2% contraction in the first three months of the year. Exports, production and domestic consumption drove growth, while public debt is flagged as a concern.
why: Gross domestic product measures the size of the economy and is a primary gauge of its health. Public debt and fiscal trends affect Israel's sovereign credit profile and bond market.
